content: The LSTM language model baseline is the same size as the stack LSTM (i.e. 2 layers, 650 hidden units, dropout of 0.5), and is therefore equivalent to an RNNG with completely right branching trees. The PRPN/ON baselines for perplexity/syntactic evaluation in Table TABREF30 also have 2 layers with 650 hidden units and 0.5 dropout. Therefore all models considered in Table TABREF30 have roughly the same capacity. For all models we share input/output word embeddings BIBREF86 . Perplexity estimation for the RNNGs and the compound PCFG uses 1000 importance-weighted samples.
